name: 13365 · Little Falls, NY
findings: ZIP 13365 (Little Falls) has 32 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13365 (Little Falls) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13365 (Little Falls) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 16% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
